description.value: Hot Delivery is a Cantonese-style Chinese restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver offering an extensive menu of chow mein, fried rice, chop suey, seafood, and dim sum. The restaurant operates primarily as a pickup and dine-in spot with an active online ordering system, making it straightforward for cyclists to order ahead. Indoor seating is available according to OSM tags.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (4 spaces) at 90m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, address (3002 Cambie St., Vancouver, BC), and provides a phone number (604) 879-5292) not present in OSM. The online ordering interface explicitly offers pick-up orders, confirming takeout. The site posts a one-day temporary closure notice for June 2nd (today), which is not a permanent closure; OSM check_date of 2025-10-23 further supports ongoing operation.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides (604) 879-5292 — added from website source.
Website shows a temporary one-day closure notice for Tuesday June 2nd (today's date); this is not a permanent closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Chinese restaurant with a confirmed web presence, online ordering system, and recent OSM check-date. Temporarily closed on June 2nd for a one-day break only.
